en.headline: CHP records three more severe paediatric flu cases; one girl critical
en.dek: A six-year-old girl is in critical condition with influenza A complicated by encephalopathy; a three-year-old girl and 15-year-old boy are in serious condition.
body: The Centre for Health Protection on Saturday recorded three additional cases of severe paediatric influenza infection, all involving previously healthy children with no underlying conditions.

The first case is a six-year-old girl who developed fever, runny nose and cough on 3 September. She was taken to the Accident and Emergency Department of Ruttonjee Hospital and later developed generalised convulsion. She was transferred to the paediatric intensive care unit of Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital. Her respiratory specimen tested positive for influenza A virus and the clinical diagnosis is influenza A infection complicated with encephalopathy. She is in critical condition.

The second case involves a three-year-old girl who developed fever on 2 September. After generalised convulsion she was admitted to the paediatric intensive care unit of Queen Elizabeth Hospital. Her specimen tested positive for influenza A and the diagnosis is influenza A complicated with septic shock. She is in serious condition.
The third case is a 15-year-old boy who developed fever, runny nose and fatigue. He was admitted to a private hospital and remains in serious condition with influenza B complicated by septic shock.

Controller of the CHP Edwin Tsui said influenza activity has remained high since the summer season began in late June. Sixteen severe paediatric cases have been recorded since then, including one death, with two patients currently critical. He warned that more school outbreaks are expected after the start of the new academic year and urged parents and schools to stay vigilant. Seasonal influenza vaccination programmes begin on 17 September.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心再錄三宗兒童流感嚴重個案 一女童危殆
zh.dek: 六歲女童甲型流感併發腦病變情況危殆，三歲女童及十五歲男童情況嚴重，三人過往均健康良好。
body: 衞生防護中心今日錄得三宗兒童感染流感的嚴重個案，三名兒童過往均健康良好，無長期病患。
首宗個案為一名六歲女童。她自九月三日起出現發燒、流鼻水及咳嗽，到律敦治醫院急症室求診，其後出現全身抽搐，被轉送至東區尤德夫人那打素醫院兒童深切治療部。呼吸道樣本對甲型流感病毒呈陽性，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發腦病變，目前情況危殆。
第二宗個案為一名三歲女童。她九月二日起發燒，其後出現全身抽搐，入住伊利沙伯醫院兒童深切治療部。樣本對甲型流感呈陽性，診斷為甲型流感併發敗血性休克，目前情況嚴重。
第三宗個案為一名十五歲男童，出現發燒、流鼻水及疲倦，入住私家醫院，診斷為乙型流感併發敗血性休克，情況嚴重。
中心總監徐樂堅表示，本港自六月底進入流感季節，流感活躍程度持續高企。至今累計錄得十六宗兒童嚴重個案，包括一宗死亡，另有兩人危殆。他預料開學後學校或出現爆發，呼籲家長及學校提高警惕，並提醒市民於九月十七日開始的季節性流感疫苗接種計劃盡早接種。
